next_batch.measurement_design: 5 actual Rongbay LLM contracts x 3 models x 3 repeats. This exposes Rongbay for allocation development. Same-node fixtures identical across models and repeats; provenance-certified parent fixtures pending. Not independent confirmatory calibration.
next_batch.R: NO_RETRIES; invalid parent blocks descendants equally
next_batch.planning: Before evaluation: choose supported-fact coverage then latency then public cost with missing Q explicitly unknown; use only completed measurement-set reviews. No fallback selected from evaluation. Unknown infeasibility is reported as refusal. Resolve ties by predeclared model name order; Qwen a measured candidate, not automatic fallback.
next_batch.feedback: Natural source/contract failure blocks descendants; no artificial F2/F3. After healthy common prefix, observed model per-node latency ratio >1.5 against same-contract calibration median triggers reselection of all pending nodes. Apply max observed ratio only to that observed model; no unobserved quality updates. Same quality eligibility and budget/deadline rules; no private reference at runtime.
next_batch.main_outcome: Frozen terminal Q only if admissible references/relevance assessment available. Otherwise prespecified six-item source-constrained exploratory Q/E with coverage and UNKNOWN intervals, not full Q or Gold.
next_batch.stats: 3 paired repeats, one exposed event. Report all pair differences and ranges. No population superiority, no six facts treated as independent tasks, no cross-event p-value; optional exact paired sign/randomization calculation explicitly low powered and conditional on randomized order, not with fixed order here.
next_batch.no_switch: Retain pair in denominator; report no action divergence, not causal reassignment benefit
next_batch.termination: One authorized batch only; no retries/extra samples. API or usage/accounting anomaly, aggregate reserved spend limit, batch deadline -> stop. Normal model failure -> retain costs and block dependent nodes, continue independent cells. Invalid measurement fixtures or unresolved semantic scoring -> do not dispatch.
